title: Smallpox in Tenochtitlan, Florentine Codex, Book XII (fol. 54)
creator: Nahua artists working with Bernardino de Sahagún
why_public_domain: A 16th-century manuscript drawing; a faithful photographic copy of a public-domain two-dimensional work adds no new copyright in the US.
original_holder: Biblioteca Medicea Laurenziana, Florence (Med. Palat. 220); image as reproduced in OpenStax World History, credited via Wikimedia Commons
caption: Nahua painters' picture of the sickness that came in 1520: people covered in pox lie wrapped on mats while one is tended. It was drawn about fifty years after the epidemic for Sahagún's Book XII, from the memories of survivors. This is a modern photograph of the manuscript page, not a pre-1929 book reproduction.
